findings.evidence: Lines 100–119 set `A` and `a`, after which the entire construction uses only `Ideal.span {a}`, `RingEquiv.toOpposite A`, and `FGModuleCat.cyclicModule a`; no polynomial or matrix-factorization property is used.
findings.fix: Move and export a generic quotient-span/restricted-`cyclicModule` isomorphism, with its representative equation, in `Algebra/Category/FGModuleCat/Cyclic.lean`, then instantiate it here.
findings.issue: `rootPowQuotientCyclicIso` is private and artificially specialized, although its construction uses only a commutative ring `A` and an element `a`; this hides reusable general infrastructure.

findings.evidence: The theorem rewrites an application of `(powerXOfLECokernelIso R hi).hom` to a cokernel representative into the canonical quotient representative, while the parallel morphism-level rule at line 62 is already a simp lemma.
findings.fix: Mark the theorem `@[simp]` (or provide an equivalent simp-normal-form lemma if dependent elaboration requires a differently shaped statement).
findings.issue: `powerXOfLECokernelIso_hom_cokernelπ` is the characteristic representative-reduction rule for the exported isomorphism but lacks a `@[simp]` annotation.

summary: The public surface hides a genuinely general quotient-to-cyclic-module comparison and omits automation on the final representative equation.
